name: Watershed Action Team (Boise WaterShed)
what_you_do: Help build and run water and climate lessons at the Boise WaterShed. You also work at WaterShed events and community STEM nights.
who_can_apply: Youth ages 15 to 18 from Boise and the Treasure Valley who like water and climate topics. You must be able to give the required hours.
pay_detail: Paid position. The hourly pay is not stated on the program page.
duration: Training in the first week of June, then 5 hours every Wednesday (9 AM to 2 PM) until school starts in August. Some evenings and weekends, and year-round work is possible.
deadline_text: Applications for 2026 are closed. The program page says applications are typically open in March for the following summer.
how_to_apply: The program page has no application link right now. Email WaterShed@CityOfBoise.org or call (208) 608-7309 to ask about the next round.
notes: Interview steps are not stated on the program page. The WaterShed is at 6411 N. Ancell Ave, Boise.
